description: Query audit logs (governance receipts) from Tork Cloud — the org-scoped record of real agent activity. Supports filtering by agent, action type, and date range. Requires TORK_API_KEY.

limit.description: Maximum number of logs to return (default: 100, max: 1000)

since.description: ISO timestamp to filter logs after

until.description: ISO timestamp to filter logs before

name: tork_cloud_audit_logs
